zenodo_13900966_deduplication.finding: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.13900966 is confirmed to be the identical Bone Scan Images Dataset for Study of Bone Metastases in Adult Breast Cancer Patients at IICS-UNA Paraguay already in ml_service/data/raw/bone_scan_metastasis.
zenodo_13900966_deduplication.action: Flagged as duplicate; no new download required; recognized as in-tree asset.

figshare_oi_animal_microct_correction.finding: Figshare DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.c.3795019 represents micro-CT reconstructions of tibiae in oim mice (Ranzoni et al.), NOT human clinical radiographs.
figshare_oi_animal_microct_correction.action: Formally reclassified as ANIMAL_OR_SYNTHETIC_ONLY; strictly rejected from clinical model pipeline.

pmc11324408_access_barrier.finding: PMC11324408 utilizes the Brittle Bone Disorders Consortium (BBDC) Natural History Study under RDCRN. Full radiographic series are not open downloads and require a formal Data Management and Coordinating Center (DMCC) application.

radiopaedia_terms_of_reference.finding: Radiopaedia terms strictly prohibit automated harvesting or scraping of images for machine-learning model training without a formal license agreement.
radiopaedia_terms_of_reference.action: Reclassified as EDUCATIONAL_ONLY; commercial deployment strictly prohibited.

stanford_mura_anatomical_scope.finding: Stanford AIMI MURA normal cohort is radiologist-verified with patient IDs, but covers upper extremities ONLY (elbow, finger, forearm, hand, humerus, shoulder, wrist).
stanford_mura_anatomical_scope.action: Reclassified as upper-extremity comparator only; cannot represent whole-skeleton normal control.

secondary_bone_metastasis.verified_in_tree_data: 60 patients (120 images) in planar scintigraphy (IICS-UNA Paraguay)
secondary_bone_metastasis.modality_limitation: Scintigraphy and CT only; zero plain X-rays in-tree

pagets_disease_of_bone.best_external_candidate: Hospital Clinical Collaboration / Radiopaedia Educational Cohort
pagets_disease_of_bone.modality_limitation: No standardized public ML benchmark exists; educational cases require written license

osteogenesis_imperfecta.modality_limitation: Pediatric skewed; requires formal consortium DUA approval

healthy_skeletal_control.verified_in_tree_data: 1,600 clean radiographs (BTXRD Center 1 normal - unverified patient IDs)
healthy_skeletal_control.modality_limitation: MURA is upper extremity only; FracAtlas non-fractured rejected as trauma

governance_rule: No model training or automated dataset downloads permitted.
